SYMPTOM: catalog_ids=1809 (polo shirts) returns 0 results on vinted.lt
CAUSE: Subcategory IDs are marketplace-specific. vinted.com catalog IDs don't exist on vinted.lt
FIX: Use broad parent categories only:
- Men's clothing: 5
- Women's clothing: 1904
- Men's shoes: 1231
- Women's shoes: 16
- Men's accessories: 302
- Women's accessories: 1922
WHY: Subcategories (polo shirts, chinos etc) use different numeric IDs per country marketplace. Parent categories are consistent.
GOTCHA: Never use subcategory IDs from docs or other marketplaces — always test against vinted.lt specifically
